name: MagicInterview AI
tagline: Know what to say next in job interviews, client calls, and meetings—with context from your CV, brief, and notes.
description: MagicInterview gives you live, context-grounded suggestions for what to say during job interviews, prospective-client calls, sales conversations, and other meetings. Connect your workspace to Claude to create or update a conversation with your CV and job description, or a client brief and notes. Keep shared project context alongside meeting-specific details, then open the exact conversation in MagicInterview on your computer or phone while you speak. MagicInterview can retrieve saved turns, provide coaching, and return a direct link to your conversation. Requires a MagicInterview account and OAuth sign-in. Calendar, CRM, and web research use the capabilities available to your assistant.
